questions.stem_text:
Neighbor says his home repair contract needs to be discharged because of frustration of
purpose. Which of the following is not required for this to be discharged for this reason?

options.B: That was reasonably foreseeable at time of contract formation.
options.C: Which completely or almost completely destroys the purpose of the contract.
options.D: The purpose of the contract was understood by both parties.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - That was reasonably foreseeable at time of contract formation.

questions.stem_text:
There is a grand jury proceeding underway for a local businessman. What is not true about
grand jury proceedings?

options.A: The proceedings are conducted in secret.
options.B: There is no right to counsel.
options.C: There is a right to Miranda warnings.
options.D: There is no right to have evidence excluded.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - There is a right to Miranda warnings.

questions.stem_text:
There is a voting law that is going to be reviewed by the court. If the law is upheld,
what must be true?

options.A: The law is necessary to achieve a compelling government purpose.
options.B: The law is substantially related to an important government purpose.
options.C: The law is rationally related to a legitimate government purpose.
options.D: The law is substantially related to a legitimate government purpose.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - The law is necessary to achieve a compelling government purpose.
